title: The localized product-complex Roos triangle
statement: The localized product-complex Roos triangle. Let A be an abelian category with exact countable products, enough injectives and derived localization Q [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let I be a K-injective cochain complex of inverse systems [def-sp-kinjective-bridge]. Let c be any limit cone of I.asFunctor and P any product fan of its evaluated complexes, with their IsLimit witnesses. Suppose iota : c.pt → P.pt and t : P.pt → P.pt satisfy iota followed by projection n equals the n-th leg of c and t followed by projection n equals projection n minus projection n+1 followed by the transition. Then some delta : Q(P.pt) → Q(c.pt)[1] makes the triangle Q(c.pt) → Q(P.pt) → Q(P.pt) → Q(c.pt)[1], with arrows Q(iota), Q(t), delta, distinguished [def-weil-triangulated-category]. There is no assumption or conclusion that Q(P.pt) is a product in the derived category.

source.place: Tags 0BK7 and 070M; arbitrary K-injective extension and kernel-cone comparison in lem-weil-derived-limit-roos-complex

proof.text: Evaluation of complexes preserves limits. The product fan therefore identifies each degree of P.pt with the product of the tower terms in that degree. The projection equations and the universal property of c identify iota degreewise with the kernel of t. Form the shifted cone of t with the canonical comparison having components (0,iota); its differentials and projections are the data required by the Roos comparison theorem.

Apply roosComplex_quasiIso to the degreewise product isomorphisms, kernel forks and shifted-cone data. This proves that the comparison localizes to an isomorphism even for arbitrary K-injective towers.

Localize the mapping-cone triangle and rotate backwards. The comparison isomorphism, with the standard sign isomorphism on its first object, transports it to a distinguished triangle whose first two maps are Q(iota) and Q(t). Its third map is delta.

theorem derivedCategory_tower_roos_triangle
    (A : Type u) [Category.{v} A] [Abelian A] [HasDerivedCategory.{w} A]
    [HasCountableProducts A] [CountableAB4Star A] [EnoughInjectives A]
    (I : CochainComplex (ℕᵒᵖ ⥤ A) ℤ) [I.IsKInjective]
    (c : Cone I.asFunctor) (hc : IsLimit c)
    (P : Fan (fun n : ℕ ↦ I.asFunctor.obj (Opposite.op n))) (hP : IsLimit P)
    (iota : c.pt ⟶ P.pt) (t : P.pt ⟶ P.pt)
    (hiota : ∀ n : ℕ, iota ≫ P.proj n = c.π.app (Opposite.op n))
    (ht : ∀ n : ℕ, t ≫ P.proj n = P.proj n -
      P.proj (n + 1) ≫ I.asFunctor.map (homOfLE (Nat.le_succ n)).op) :
    ∃ δ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.pt ⟶ (DerivedCategory.Q.obj c.pt)⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      Pretriangulated.Triangle.mk (DerivedCategory.Q.map iota)
        (DerivedCategory.Q.map t) δ ∈ distTriang (DerivedCategory A)
